name: cursor-glyph-trail
description: A tutorial cursor path: on a settings screen the arrow clicks through three steps, leaving a dotted trail spaced evenly by distance and a numbered marker at each click; each step's trail fades as the next move begins.

vars.description: Deprecated and ignored: the trail draws evenly spaced dots.
How each move bends: sweep is a gentle curve, arc a deeper one, zigzag a straight line.
Seconds a step trail takes to fade once the next move begins, clamped 0.3 to 1.5.
Trail and step marker color: green rides --brand, blue rides --accent, violet rides --accent-2.
Optional departure. Default none: the finished screen holds until the frame cuts.
